method_note: Prediction from this packet and general reasoning only, with no observed generations. I shrink imperfect atlas descriptions and vocabulary projections toward a neutral helpful baseline at the actual half-reference doses. Projection cues inform female/male, paws, kawaii and topic effects while semantic labels provide uncertain additional evidence; contradictory prose directions are not treated as causal guarantees. Opposite signs are assessed separately. Identity prompts permit more explicit self-role than short tasks and attributed fiction; social prompts permit more cute style and affection. Paired interventions receive modest disruption and selected complementary-cue interactions. Joint feline/female/coherent probabilities reflect shared persona evidence rather than marginal independence; usefulness remains separate.
